# Subham Khandual — Full-Stack MERN & AI Developer Portfolio

> Portfolio of Subham Khandual, a Full-Stack MERN & AI developer based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India.
> The site showcases featured projects, technical skills, experience, certifications, achievements and contact details.

## Primary pages and sections

- [Home / Hero](https://portfolio-nine-alpha-8nkzp7nnk6.vercel.app/#home): Introduction, role, resume download and social profiles.
- [About](https://portfolio-nine-alpha-8nkzp7nnk6.vercel.app/#about): Background, education and engineering focus.
- [Skills](https://portfolio-nine-alpha-8nkzp7nnk6.vercel.app/#skills): Frontend, backend, database, language and tooling proficiency.
- [Projects](https://portfolio-nine-alpha-8nkzp7nnk6.vercel.app/#projects): Suraksha Setu, Swasthya Setu, Sayraa AI PPT Generator, Sayraa AI Health Care Assistant and Envistream Eduskill Chatbot.
- [Experience](https://portfolio-nine-alpha-8nkzp7nnk6.vercel.app/#experience): Professional and internship timeline.
- [Achievements](https://portfolio-nine-alpha-8nkzp7nnk6.vercel.app/#achievements): Projects shipped, repositories, certifications, hackathons and DSA problems solved.
- [GitHub](https://portfolio-nine-alpha-8nkzp7nnk6.vercel.app/#github): Open-source repositories and statistics.
- [Certificates](https://portfolio-nine-alpha-8nkzp7nnk6.vercel.app/#certificates): CTTC and NPTEL certifications with verified credential links.
- [Contact](https://portfolio-nine-alpha-8nkzp7nnk6.vercel.app/#contact): Direct message form, email, WhatsApp and location.
